assertion.en: Homo neanderthalensis and Homo sapiens were alive on earth at the same time.

reason.en: Each human species ended at the moment the next species began.

a.en: The Reason is false. If each species ended as the next began, no two would ever share the earth.

b.en: The Reason is false, so it cannot be true alongside the Assertion. Species overlapped for long stretches.

d.en: The Assertion is true. Homo sapiens goes back about 300,000 years, and Neanderthals lived until about 40,000 years ago.

explanation.en: A is true and R is false. Homo sapiens evolved about 300,000 years ago, and Neanderthals lived until about 40,000 years ago, so the two overlapped. Evolution is not a relay race: different kinds of human ancestors lived at the same time.

hints.en: Compare two dates: when Homo sapiens began, and when Neanderthals ended.
